sentences.text: Lab Report: Text classification with neural networks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
Each experiment was repeated 3 times with different random seeds.
The dataset was split into 70 percent training data and the rest for testing.
Figure 1 shows the test accuracy of Baseline by dataset.
Baseline scores 26.5 points higher on Fashion-MNIST than on CIFAR-10.
Baseline reaches 62.2% test accuracy on MNIST.
Figure 2 shows the validation accuracy of ResNet-50 by dataset.
As shown in Figure 2, ResNet-50 scores 2 points higher on SVHN than on AG News.
ResNet-50 achieves 86% validation accuracy on CIFAR-10.
ResNet-50 scores 2.0 points higher on AG News than on SST-2.
As shown in Figure 2, ResNet-50 achieves 69.1% validation accuracy on SVHN.
Logistic Regression reaches 72.7% accuracy on MNIST.
We note that the training was stable for all models.
